prompt: Convert $2.5$ kilograms to grams. ($1$ kg $= 1000$ g)
hint: A kilogram is a thousand times heavier than a gram. Expect the number of grams to be much larger than $2.5$.

hints.text: A kilogram is a thousand times heavier than a gram. Expect the number of grams to be much larger than $2.5$.
Multiply $2.5$ by $1000$. Multiplying by $1000$ moves the decimal point three places to the right.
$2.5 \times 1000 = 2500$, so a mass of $2.5$ kilograms is $2500$ grams.

explanation: The conversion fact is $1$ kilogram $= 1000$ grams, so kilograms are multiplied by $1000$.
Think of $2.5$ kilograms as $2$ kilograms plus half a kilogram.
Two kilograms is $2000$ grams and half a kilogram is $500$ grams, so the total is $2500$.
A mass of $2.5$ kilograms is the same as $2500$ grams.
